svg.title: Penguin mass predictions and 90% intervals in grams
svg.desc: Gaussian and Student predictions of 2009 adult penguin mass in grams, trained on 2007–2008. Vertical central 90% predictive intervals include coefficient uncertainty and fixed residual variation; the diagonal is exact point prediction. Student intervals are narrower but cover fewer held-out masses; typical prediction errors are about 400 grams.
